highlights.title: Agents keep going when a message is flagged
highlights.line: When Claude flags a message, an agent on Opus 5.5 now switches to Opus 4.8 and carries on, instead of stopping on a question nobody sees.

highlights.title: The Guide says when it is out of usage
highlights.line: When the Guide's Claude account hits its usage limit, the Guide now says so and keeps helping on Kosmos's backup, instead of going quiet.

highlights.title: See a file full page
highlights.line: Click a file attached to a message to see it full page, then open it in Finder or download it.

highlights.title: Hold to talk
highlights.line: In the Mac app, hold the mic to talk, and the text boxes in dialogs now have a mic too.
